_meta.source: CDC NIS-Child, Health, United States Table 031 (1998–2017) and the HUS 2011 trend table (1995–1997)
_meta.breaks: 2011 NIS-Child added a cell-phone sample to the historically landline-only frame; series ends 2017 when NCIRD moved routine reporting to birth-cohort estimates.
_meta.name: DTaP ≥4 doses, children 19–35 months
_meta.note: Share receiving at least four diphtheria, tetanus, and acellular pertussis doses. CDC NIS-Child estimates for children 19–35 months are assigned to survey year. A cell-phone sample was added in 2011. This series ends in 2017 and must not be spliced to the birth-cohort series at 24 months.
